name: Banana Bread
instructions: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 900g loaf tin with baking paper.
Whisk the melted butter, sugar, eggs, milk and honey until smooth.
Stir the mashed banana through the wet mixture.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt until only just combined.
Fold in most of the walnuts, scrape into the tin and scatter the rest on top.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out with only moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.
